column3: Arrival ★ City of Kyoto
Are you all right, Kyou-chan?
I'm all right... All right... *yawn*
So you really didn't sleep much last night? I would have lent you my lap as a pillow on the bullet train if you asked.
No, better not do that.
But the school trip is about to start and you're sleepy...
Of course, I would've been able to sleep soundly if I used Manami's lap...
Also, it's written in the guidebook that Kyoto is awfully hot during summer.
...Kyou-chan?
...ZZZZZ
Kyou-chan! You can sleep even while standing?!
Uwoh! Not good, not good!
See, the sun is intense. If you feel unwell on the way, do tell me!
Yeah, thank you.
I brought some rock candy, it helps with fatigue～
More old lady's knowledge!
...It's really astonishing that you know such stuff.
Eh? Eh? Is that so?
...Huh? What's with that?
You doubt it? It's true! Grandma told me that!
Furthermore, I brought teabags to use in tonight's bath.
What did you bring them for?
Don't you know? Red tea has moisturizing components; it's great for skin that has been overexposed to the sunlight.
About that... you intend to use it in a public bath?
...That's right...
I guess I can't just use teabags when everyone's here～
That's not the point! It's the space! The bath is too big!
...Using teabags in the bath? I don't get it.
Ehehe. I'm pretty well-prepared, aren't I?
Well, I won't pry any further...
Anyway, it doesn't concern me.
Then, Kyou-chan should use a teabag.
You don't have to hold back. Don't worry about me～
There's no way I'm taking this thing.
This thing... I just want you to get better...
Ugh... She was caring for me and I ended up saying something cruel...
U-Understood! I've got it!
I'm fine already!
Truly?
Yeah, seriously. Let's enjoy Kyoto.
H-However...
You don't need to hold back～
Though, rather than that, Manami's smile greatly lifted my spirits.
I want Kyou-chan to get better～
Thank you.
Are you feeling better?
Guess so.
I'm all right now!
Really?
Yeah, really. Let's enjoy this Kyoto trip.
Really? You're not lying to me, right?
I'm not lying!
Anyway, I'm very worried about Kyou-chan～
I-I get it! I get it!
I'm all right now!
Really?
Yeah, really. So let's enjoy our trip.
Ye-Yes...
You don't look good at all though...
You don't have to force yourself, you know?
I'm not... forcing... myself... at all.
...Well, Let's have some fun.
Ah, yes...
